sources.title: Philippine Registry of Cultural Property (NCCA): Naga City entries
sources.note: Inspected October 9, 2026. Quince Martires del Bicolandia Monument (Labinlimang Martir ng Bikol): NHCP marked structure, marker unveiled 1982, with the marker text. The registry listing is the basis for this landmark's Heritage legend membership.

text.en: Its NHCP marker, unveiled in 1982, recalls the Bicol ilustrados arrested and tried by a Spanish military commission on December 29, 1896.
The marker calls them innocent of the charge of plotting to kill every Spaniard in the Bicol region.
Eleven were shot at Luneta in Manila; two died in prison and two in exile, and their remains lie in a single grave that was never found.
